title: zone
description: A zone, at places/continents/<c>/zones/<key>.json. The key is fixed when the zone is made; the name can change.

region.description: A multipolygon in tile units: polygons, each a list of rings (outline first, then holes), each ring a list of [x, z] corners, implicitly closed.

levels.description: [min, max], the levels it is built for
